title: Dimension of the special fibre of a partial Popescu chart
statement: Let R,Cbar,pi and d be the compatible prepared data of [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]. Write Q=R[x,z], u_l=f_l-pi*z_l and p_kl=a_k*z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_klj*z_j-pi*g_kl. Fix k and define D_k=ULift(Q/(u_l for l in E_k,p_kl for l outside E_k)), with its canonical quotient map to D=d.liftingAlgebra. Let q be a prime of D containing pi and avoiding the image of a_k. Let S be the explicitly renumbered quotient of R[Fin(n+m)] by the m chart equations and e:S to D_k the explicit algebra equivalence induced by finSumFinEquiv and ULift. Let qprime be the inverse image in S of q, and p its contraction to R. The topological dimension at the corresponding prime of the fibre kappa(p) tensor_R S is n [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], with fibres and localizations as in [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. No Noetherian or annihilator-equality assumption is needed for this dimension assertion.

proof.text: Construct D_k explicitly as ULift of Q modulo one equation for each l: u_l on E_k, p_kl on its complement. Each relation belongs to the full defining ideal, giving the explicit quotient map D_k to D. Renumber the variables by finSumFinEquiv; finiteChartEquiv is the quotient algebra equivalence, proved by mapping the span of the equations.

proof.text: Pull pi and the nonmembership of a_k back along finiteChartEquiv and chartMap to qprime. Its contraction p contains pi, hence pi is zero in B=kappa(p). Construct the compatible R/pi^2-algebra structure on B by quotient lifting. The fibre prime qF avoids t=1 tensor s, by the inverse identity of PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber. Apply popescu_partial_chart_polynomial to finiteChartEquation (its defining equality is reflexive) to identify the localization of the fibre at t with the polynomial algebra in card(E_k) variables over C=B tensor_(R/pi^2) Localization.Away(reducedElement k).

proof.text: Prepared.smooth and smooth base change make C smooth over B; the finite polynomial extension is smooth by composition. Transfer smoothness through the polynomial model. Base change the Prepared.differentials basis to C and map it through KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv. The polynomial-extension theorem gives a basis of rank (n-card E_k)+card E_k. Install the polynomial-model algebra structure on the localized fibre L; its algebra equivalence is formally etale, so tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale transports the base-changed polynomial differential basis to Omega[L/B]. Base change that basis to the residue field of a prime Q of L. Its finrank is n by Prepared.card_le and Nat.sub_add_cancel.

proof.text: The range of the spectrum map of localization at t is basicOpen t. Because qF avoids t, choose a prime Q over it. Smoothness of L gives a smooth principal neighbourhood of Q by localizing at 1. Apply finiteDimensional_and_finrank_kaehlerDifferential_eq_of_isSmoothAtPrime to Q. The differential residue basis makes its dimension n. The spectrum map of principal localization is an open embedding; apply the existing Algebra.dimAt_openEmbedding from SmoothAtPrimeDifferentialsDimension, made available by the proof-only import all, to preserve dimension at the chosen prime. Thus dimension at qF equals dimension at Q, proving the original finite-chart fibre dimension without changing its statement.

lean.statement:
theorem partial_chart_fibre_dimension [Algebra R Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (k : Fin d.r) (q : PrimeSpectrum d.liftingAlgebra)
    (hπ : algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π ∈ q.asIdeal)
    (hk : ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk d.definingIdeal (d.includeX (d.a k))) ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    let q' := PrimeSpectrum.comap (d.finiteChartEquiv k).toRingHom (d.chartPrime k q)
    let p := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (d.finiteChartAlgebra k)) q'
    topologicalKrullDimAt
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R (d.finiteChartAlgebra k) p ⟨q', rfl⟩) =
        (d.n : WithBot ℕ∞)
